trap.label: gerúndio
trap.wrong: It’s worth to visit the museum.
trap.why: Português “vale a pena visitar” usa infinitivo. Em inglês worth e no use são seguidos de -ing.

mcq.q: It’s no use **___** at the door.
O oposto de It’s worth it:

fix.wrong: It’s no use to argue with him.
fix.right: It’s no use arguing with him.

fix.wrong: The trail is worth to see.

rewrite.prompt: Transforme em pergunta: “The museum is worth visiting.”
